sources.title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6: Powering real-world robotics tasks through enhanced embodied reasoning
sources.evidence: April 14, 2026 announcement says ER 1.6 is available starting that day through Gemini API and AI Studio. Describes spatial reasoning, task planning, success detection, instrument reading, and native calls to user-defined functions.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 model card
sources.evidence: April 2026 card identifies a vision-language model based on Gemini 3.0 Flash, accepting text/images/audio/video and returning text. Its Architecture section explicitly directs readers to the Gemini 3.0 Flash card. Gives no total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER 1.6 API model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview table confirms preview variant, 131,072 input tokens, text/image/video/audio inputs, text output, Thinking Supported and Function calling Supported. Page updated October 8, 2026; its separate Latest update December 2025 cell conflicts with the release announcement. The Versions row marks this preview as shut down.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash model card
sources.evidence: The architecture reference linked by ER 1.6: printed page 1 states Gemini 3 Flash is based on Gemini 3 Pro and explicitly refers readers to the Gemini 3 Pro model card for architecture. Does not disclose production parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro model card, updated May 2026
sources.evidence: Terminal document in the explicit ER 1.6 architecture-reference chain. Printed page 3 defines Gemini 3 Pro as a sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer with multimodal inputs, activating a subset of parameters per token. No numeric total or active parameter count is given.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Terms effective March 23, 2026 govern Gemini API and AI Studio access, impose use restrictions, and prohibit extracting or replicating underlying model parameter weights. Supports proprietary hosted-access classification, rather than treating page-content or code-example licenses as model licenses.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 model card
sources.evidence: Later July 2026 robotics card was checked for predecessor specifications. It gives no numeric total or active parameter count for ER 1.6; ER 2 is based on Gemini 3.5 Flash, which is not substituted for ER 1.6.

sources.title: Introducing Gemini Robotics ER 2
sources.evidence: July 30, 2026 successor announcement explicitly compares ER 1.6 in robot-control and spatial-reasoning benchmarks. Those comparisons do not provide total or active production parameter counts for ER 1.6.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics 2: Safety Technical Report
sources.evidence: Later safety report linked by the ER 2 model card was checked. It supplies no ER 1.6 production parameter counts or architecture disclosure; no specifications from its other robotics models are transferred.

sources.title: Gemini deprecations
sources.evidence: Robotics table explicitly lists gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview release April 14, 2026, shutdown date August 31, 2026, and replacement ER 2 Preview. Page cautions shutdown dates are earliest possible dates.

sources.title: Gemini Robotics ER overview
sources.evidence: Current overview states ER 1.6 was deprecated August 31, 2026 and recommends switching the exact API identifier to ER 2. Specifications in this audit are documented ER 1.6 behavior, not proof that its endpoint still operates.

name.note: Developer card names ER 1.6; exact API model table identifies the preview variant.

developer.note: Developed and announced by Google DeepMind; Google is the existing catalog developer grouping.

family.note: The exact card explicitly places this model in the Gemini 3.0 family.

release_date.note: Same-day API availability in the launch and exact-ID release table agree. April 20 is model-card publication, not first release. The API table's December 2025 Latest update cell does not override these explicit release sources.

open_weights.note: Developer distributes this model through hosted Gemini API/AI Studio access under restrictive service terms; no public weights are provided in the reviewed release sources.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted model access under Google service terms, not an SPDX license. Documentation and sample-code licenses do not license the weights.

parameters_b.note: No exact ER 1.6 total count is disclosed in its card, referenced architecture cards, later ER 2 card/comparisons, or linked safety report. Targeted first-party parameter/training/interpretability searches found no additional count. No sibling count is inferred.

active_parameters_b.note: The referenced MoE description explains sparse activation but provides no numeric active count for ER 1.6. Later cards and comparisons checked do not disclose one; it cannot be derived from context limits or benchmark results.

architecture.note: Explicit architecture-reference chain: ER 1.6 directs to Gemini 3 Flash, which directs to Gemini 3 Pro; the terminal card states sparse MoE Transformer. This supports the architectural class, not inherited numeric sizes or context limits.

context_window.note: Exact preview API table gives an input token limit of 131,072; the model card rounds this to 128k.

modalities.note: The exact model card and endpoint table agree on all four input modalities and text-only output.

reasoning.note: Thinking is explicitly supported in the exact preview endpoint table.

tool_call.note: Exact endpoint table supports function calling; launch describes native third-party function calls.

description.value: Vision-language model based on Gemini 3.0 Flash for spatial reasoning, task planning, success detection, and instrument reading in robotics.
description.note: Replaces broad agentic wording with the documented base model and concrete robotics tasks.

patch.notes: Sparse MoE Transformer architecture follows the explicit ER 1.6, Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3 Pro model-card references. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed. These are historical preview specifications: Google marks the endpoint as shut down and lists August 31, 2026 as its shutdown date.

summary: Confirmed exact preview identity, April 14, 2026 release, 131,072-token input limit, modalities, reasoning and tool calling. Added proprietary classification and MoE architecture via the model cards' explicit architecture-reference chain; made description factual. Total and active counts remain null/undisclosed after exact-model and later first-party comparison/report checks. Preserved release date despite conflicting API Latest update metadata; recorded deprecation without claiming endpoint operation.
